title: Decision: did_log JSON Lines details (CR LF refused, inner whitespace allowed, missing final LF refused)
description:
draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential-00 §did:webvh Profile, Encoding: "did_log MUST be UTF-8 JSON Lines: one JSON object per line, each line ending in a single LF (0x0A), with no blank lines and nothing after the last LF."

Gaps: (1) CR LF: JSON Lines (jsonlines.org) tolerates \r\n because whitespace around a value is ignored; "a single LF" suggests not. (2) JSON whitespace inside a line (spaces between tokens) is not forbidden; did:webvh says entries have "all extra whitespace removed" but hashes over JCS, so whitespace does not affect validity under v1.0. (3) An empty did_log.

Chosen: a line ending in CR before its LF is refused; other JSON whitespace inside a line is accepted (hashes are over JCS, so it cannot change meaning); an empty did_log is refused (it must hold the first entry). Observed: in the DIF did:webvh test suite (commit 703f97f) the dart and java implementations write no final LF, so this profile rejects their logs; python, rust, ts and java-eecc conform. For -01: decide whether to tolerate a missing final LF (that would cost nothing, since entries are delimited anyway) and say CR LF and whitespace explicitly. crates/mls-didwebvh/src/verify.rs lines().
close_reason: Chosen by agent per the reading in the description; recorded in docs/didwebvh-draft-feedback.md for -01; flag to Mark
